name: Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque
description: A vast white marble mosque with reflecting pools and space for tens of thousands of worshippers.

name: Burj Khalifa
description: The world’s tallest tower rises above Downtown Dubai with observation decks.

name: Burj Al Arab
description: A sail-shaped luxury hotel on an artificial island off Jumeirah.

name: Louvre Abu Dhabi
description: A domed museum on Saadiyat Island presenting global art under a patterned roof.

name: Dubai Frame
description: A large picture-frame structure in Zabeel Park overlooking old and new Dubai.

name: Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve
description: Protected dunes for wildlife and guided desert experiences inland from the city.

name: Palm Jumeirah
description: A palm-shaped artificial island with beaches and a monorail spine.

name: Al Ain Oasis
description: A UNESCO palm oasis with falaj irrigation channels in Al Ain.

name: Yas Island
description: Entertainment island with parks, marina and motorsport venues.

name: Hatta heritage & dams
description: Mountain village with heritage houses and reservoir landscapes near Oman.

name: Spice Souk
description: Covered lanes in Deira sell spices, teas and sweets.

name: Global Village food pavilions
description: Seasonal cultural park with national food stalls (open in cooler months).

name: Al Qattara Arts Centre café area
description: Heritage and arts precinct with cafés in Al Ain’s cultural district.

name: Mina Fish Market
description: A working fish market near the port with fresh catch and simple grills.

name: Dubai Mall dining
description: Hundreds of restaurants surround the fountain court beneath Burj Khalifa.

name: Dubai Shopping Festival
description: A winter festival of sales, fireworks and events across Dubai.
